content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am programming an ATS using a handmade draft with GRAFCET, then writing the code in ladder format within [product_name] software. This is my first time doing this—any suggestions or advice? Also, how can I increase the size of the workspace window? When I start coding, I quickly run out of space after just a few lines. Thank you in advance for your support.
My main advice: use FBD programming instead of ladder. To adjust the diagram editor's page count, there is a specific button for that (refer to the attached image).

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces limitations with the available workspace while working in ladder diagram mode in [product_name] software and requests help to expand this area, as well as general programming tips. Another user prefers FBD mode because it offers certain advantages and mentions the button for increasing the number of pages in the workspace editor.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for an intuitive way to enlarge the ladder logic workspace and seeks clearer, beginner-friendly support regarding workspace management.
